LAREDO — A man was booked into the Webb County Jail late Sunday night on an alleged felony smuggling charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Jesus Valente Martinez was arrested on October 25, 2026, at 11:08 p.m. The booking record lists smuggling of persons, a third-degree felony. No bond amount was shown in the booking record summary available, and the arresting agency was not listed in the record.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
